items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: I think I worked with her when she was in her late 80s and she could swing you right off the bandstand.

ctx.x: You know believe it or not the person who threw people the most and was probably the most rhythmically hip was Anita O’Day. I’ve never heard anybody that could back-
phrase like that and be exactly on the money. I think I worked with her when she was in her late 80s and she could swing you right off the bandstand.
Wow. What inspired your move to the west coast?
